# via selector

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:viaSelector`](gmeow-viaSelector.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/viaSelector>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/citations`](../../slices/citations.md)

An optional pinpoint selector into the cited work — a page, text position, text quote, or locator. Non-functional: a citation may reference multiple selectors (e.g. several pages).

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:CitationAct`](../classes/gmeow-CitationAct.md) -> [`gmeow:Selector`](../classes/gmeow-Selector.md)
